Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import interact, create_engine, PageAction, CrawlConfig, BrowserConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(browser=BrowserConfig(mode="always"))
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    actions = [PageAction(selector="#open", type="click"), PageAction(selector="#field", text="test_data", type="type"), PageAction(selector="#submit", type="click")]
    result = await interact(engine, url, actions)
    print(result.action_results[0].action_index)
    print(result.action_results[0].action_type)
    print(result.action_results[0].success)
    print(result.action_results[1].action_index)
    print(result.action_results[1].action_type)
    print(result.action_results[1].success)
    print(result.action_results[2].action_index)
    print(result.action_results[2].action_type)
    print(result.action_results[2].success)

asyncio.run(main())
```
